name: NextDNS
description: NextDNS is a DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) client and resolver that blocks ads, trackers and malware using cloud-managed profiles. It serves DNS for your network on port 53; profiles are managed at my.nextdns.io, there is no local web interface.

app_vars.name: var_nextdns_profile
app_vars.label: NextDNS Profile ID
app_vars.help: From https://my.nextdns.io — used with nextdns install -profile … -report-client-info -setup-router

notes.text: Have your NextDNS profile ID from https://my.nextdns.io ready: the install asks for it, or pass var_nextdns_profile.
